document.abstract: The IMF is a file-based framework for the exchange and processing of multiple content versions (airline edits, special edition, languages…) of the same high-quality finished work (feature, episode, trailer, advertisement, etc) destined for distribution channels worldwide. Specialization of the IMF Framework designed to meet the requirements of specific domains is achieved through the definition of IMF Applications. Provisions common to all IMF Applications are specified in SMPTE ST 2067-2 ("Core Constraints"), while separate documents contain provisions specific to individual IMF Applications.
